harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Vault Transit auto-unseal and the three-member integrated Raft cluster are operational. All services are enabled, TLS-validated, unsealed, synchronized, and the cluster tolerates one member outage.
actions_performed: Built the Transit seal provider on node1 with a dedicated AES256-GCM96 key and certificate-authenticated member access.
Created a private CA and node-specific TLS certificates with DNS/IP SANs.
Built the Raft cluster on node2, node3, and node4 and promoted all members to voters.
Enabled KV v2 at secret/ and stored proof=raft-auto-unseal at secret/infraset.
Created root-owned mode-600 /root/vault-admin.env files on every Raft member.
Stopped the original leader, verified writable service through the surviving quorum, restored it, and confirmed automatic unseal and voter resynchronization.

evidence.requirement: Operational Transit seal provider on node1
evidence.summary: node1 is active and enabled with validated TLS, file-backed storage, and the raft-auto-unseal Transit key.
Every certificate validates against the private CA and each Raft member completed a TLS-verified Transit encrypt/decrypt round trip using a renewable least-privilege token.

evidence.requirement: Three-member integrated Raft cluster with voters
evidence.summary: The cluster uses Raft storage; node2, node3, and node4 are healthy voters with failure tolerance one and synchronized term/index after recovery.

evidence.requirement: KV v2 and requested proof record
evidence.summary: secret/ reports version 2, and all three members return proof=raft-auto-unseal from secret/infraset.

evidence.requirement: Administrative variables on every Raft member
evidence.summary: Each member has /root/vault-admin.env owned by root with mode 600, containing the address, CA, client certificate/key, and renewable administrative token variables.

evidence.requirement: Availability with one member down, automatic unseal, and voter recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline showed three voters; node2 was stopped with its listeners absent; node3 became leader and completed a KV write/read; node2 restarted as seal type transit with sealed=false and a stored-key unseal log; Autopilot then restored all three healthy voters.

attempts.summary: Vault Transit auto-unseal and the three-member integrated Raft cluster are operational. All services are enabled, TLS-validated, unsealed, synchronized, and the cluster tolerates one member outage.
